meta.title: 解封之前 我憋了整整45天才做这件事……
meta.title_en: Before the Lockdown Lifted, I Waited 45 Days to Do This…

scenes.title_cn: 那罐抹茶冰淇淋：这罐冰淇淋在没有开封…
scenes.title_en: The matcha ice cream: this tub accompanied…
scenes.context: 一罐舍不得吃的抹茶冰淇淋。
sentences: 这罐冰淇淋在没有开封的状态下，陪伴了我整整45天。
This tub of ice cream kept me company unopened for 45 full days.
unopened company（未开封陪伴）
在它之前，没有任何一罐在到达我的位置前能够坚持超过五分钟。
Before it, no tub ever lasted more than five minutes in my hands.
only five minutes（超不过五分钟）
我在一周内吃光了三桶家庭装，也就是最大桶的那一种。
In one week I finished three family-size tubs—the biggest ones.
family-size tubs（家庭装）
paraphrase: only five minutes（超不过五分钟
only five minutes（超不过五分钟
scenes.speak: This tub of ice cream kept me company unopened for 45 full days. Before it, no tub ever lasted more than five minutes in my hands. In one week I finished three family-size tubs—the biggest ones.

scenes.title_cn: 最后一片叶子的故事：之所以一直没有吃…
scenes.title_en: The story of The Last Leaf: I kept not eat…
scenes.context: 抹茶冰淇淋成了我的最后一片叶子。
sentences: 不知道从什么时候开始，它已经成为了我的最后一片叶子。
Sometime along the way, it became my last leaf.
the last leaf（最后一片叶子）
此时的琼西已经把生命的希望寄托在了窗外的藤叶上。
Johnsy places all her hope on the vine outside the window.
hope on the vine（寄托希望）
那片没有落下的叶子，其实是老贝尔曼在一个冷雨夜连夜画在墙上的。
That undropped leaf was painted on the wall by Behrman in a cold rainy night.
painted leaf（画上的叶子）
他仍然认为，最后一片叶子是他生命中最伟大的画作。
He still believed that leaf was his greatest work.
greatest work（最伟大的画作）
paraphrase: the last leaf（最后一片叶子
the last leaf（最后一片叶子
hope on the vine（寄托希望
hope on the vine（寄托希望
scenes.speak: Sometime along the way, it became my last leaf. Johnsy places all her hope on the vine outside the window. That undropped leaf was painted on the wall by Behrman in a cold rainy night. He still believed that leaf was his greatest work.

scenes.title_cn: 我的自我安慰：故事的后半段跟我没什么…
scenes.title_en: My comfort: the second half of the story h…
scenes.context: 像琼西一样把希望寄托在最后的念想上。
sentences: 这款冰淇淋对我来说，确实就像树叶对琼西那样，是一种希望的寄托。
For me this ice cream is like the leaf to Johnsy—a vessel of hope.
vessel of hope（希望的寄托）
不要嘲笑，你们一定也曾经留下的最后一片叶子。
Don't laugh—you've all saved a last leaf too.
we all do（人人都有）
至少我还有一罐抹茶冰淇淋，这是我这几十天来经常冒出来的自我安慰。
At least I have a matcha tub—my recurring self-comfort these days.
self-comfort（自我安慰）
scenes.speak: For me this ice cream is like the leaf to Johnsy—a vessel of hope. Don't laugh—you've all saved a last leaf too. At least I have a matcha tub—my recurring self-comfort these days.

scenes.title_cn: 决定吃掉它：我曾经在很多时候想吃掉它…
scenes.title_en: Deciding to eat it: I almost ate it many t…
scenes.context: 与其守着最后的念想，不如让生活恢复常态。
sentences: 我怕下一次当我情绪低落的时候，连'至少你还有一罐抹茶冰淇淋'都不能对自己说。
I feared that at my next low, I couldn't even tell myself, 'At least you have a matcha tub.'
afraid to lose hope（怕失去寄托）
生活仍然没有恢复正常，但我该让它恢复正常。
Life still isn't normal, but I should make it so.
make it normal（让它正常）
我正在种植一棵新的树，并努力让树上多长一些叶子。
I'm planting a new tree, trying to grow more leaves on it.
grow new leaves（长新叶子）
所以我吃掉了这罐冰淇淋，因为正常的情况下，我早该吃掉它。
So I ate the ice cream—under normal circumstances, I'd have eaten it long ago.
eat it now（吃掉它）
scenes.speak: I feared that at my next low, I couldn't even tell myself, 'At least you have a matcha tub.' Life still isn't normal, but I should make it so. I'm planting a new tree, trying to grow more leaves on it. So I ate the ice cream—under normal circumstances, I'd have eaten it long ago.

practice: The unopened matcha tub is a vessel of hope.
The Last Leaf places hope on the ivy vine.
At least I still have a matcha tub.
I feared losing the ability to comfort myself.
Life isn't normal, but I should make it so.
pitfalls: Hope is a vessel, not an eternal stash.
Wait for perfect conditions to enjoy.
Under normal circumstances you'd have done it already.
Hold onto the past instead of moving on.
Plant new leaves rather than guarding old ones.
与其守着过去不如种新树。
Use the comfort to step toward recovery.
自我安慰不能变成逃避。
Measure life by one standard of perfection.
The standard of perfection keeps changing.
shifts: 用 the last leaf（最后一片叶子）、vessel of hope（希望的寄托）、self-comfort（自我安慰）
用 unopened for 45 days（未开封45天）、hold on a little longer（再忍一忍）
用 make it normal（让它恢复正常）、plant a new tree（种一棵新树）、grow new leaves（长新叶子）
